items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The CTE names say what each step does (cand_words, top_words, top_synsets). Aliases (cw, s, syn, tw, ts) follow normal SQL practice and are used consistently. Indentation is clean. The only flaw is trailing whitespace after some SELECT keywords.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Three single-purpose CTEs plus a final SELECT. The window function replaces the correlated subqueries. The ORDER BY appears twice, but the top-500 cut inside the CTE needs it. No dead code, and the scratch dir was removed.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: This is one declarative query with no error-handling surface. The constants 2 and 500 come from the original query's spec. COUNT(DISTINCT) handles NULLs the same way the original does.

items.name: Semantically equivalent, not just equal on this data
items.name_zh: 语义等价而非仅在当前数据上相等
items.evidence: cand_words counts totals from senses alone, and the words join runs after LIMIT 500. This assumes every senses.wordid exists in words and every synsetid in synsets, and that wordid is unique in words. The agent only checked this on current data ("NOT IN" checks); the schema has no indexes or FKs enforcing it.
